subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from he statements.

**Statements:**

Some erasers are rulers.

All rulers are copies.

All pens are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are rulers.

II. Some pens are copies.

III. Some erasers are copies.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some erasers are rulers.

All rulers are copies.

All pens are erasers.
